static_traits.name: Chen Lin
static_traits.educational_background: Currently studying for a bachelor's degree
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support, difficulty opening up to others about troubles
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar history of psychological problems in the past, never received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-Reflect, highly cooperative; emotions show Anxiety; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling like a failure and overwhelmed due to heavy debt and failing some courses; these feelings began this semester and have gradually worsened, accompanied by avoiding classes, Social isolation, and Anxiety about the future.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of failure have significantly affected my mental health and academic performance.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I carry a lot of debt or have financial problems, it means I am a failure and irresponsible as a person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids checking bills, reduces contact with others to evade evaluation; tries budgeting to control spending to make up
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault, I messed everything up

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not pass exams or fall behind in Learning, it proves I am not capable in any aspect
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids classes, wants to give up; or doubles effort in the short term to prove herself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have failed in every aspect

special_situations.event: Facing academic challenges, realizing one is behind this term
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once I cannot keep up now, I will never catch up
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Withdrawing and keeping distance from classmates/friends, reducing help-seeking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never get through this

special_situations.event: Preparing to go to class or thinking of needing to go out to meet people/attend class
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I go to class now, I will not be able to cope, embarrassing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing Anxiety and shame in the short term by not attending classes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot endure the classroom, I cannot handle it

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and understood and to prove he is capable
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure being negated and humiliated by others, fearing losing control of the future
defense_goal: Avoiding exposure of weaknesses and reducing shame by skipping classes and Reduced socializing
Gaining a sense of control through self-blame and taking responsibility onto myself

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, someone who must bear all consequences alone
object_relations.object_representation: Others will judge and be disappointed, hard to offer support

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited in counseling to examine evidence and counter-evidence related to poor grades and debt
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to simplify complex external factors into 'it is all because I am not good', internalizing external pressure as self-attack (transference tendency: imagining negative evaluations as coming from the self)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle, non-blaming tone; first validate their shame and Anxiety, then help distinguish multiple causes from controllable factors; use open-ended Questioning, encourage concretizing events and balancing evidence, avoid Reinforcing self-blame.

manifestations: Proactively isolates from friends and family, hard to open up about distress to others
Feeling unsupported by anyone, bearing debt and Academic pressure alone

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-reproach narratives centered on 'It is all my fault/I am a failure'
Hard to seek help or open up to others, worries about negative evaluation
When talking about academics and debt, overly introspects and blames herself, reducing real contact

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Could have sought help from classmates/teachers/family but chose to bear the pressure alone
Turning outward help-seeking and expression into self-blame and Withdrawal

positive_force: Having had Good academic performance and financial management experience (good grades in the past and able to manage expenses)
Having the ability for self-Reflection and evidence balancing (able to acknowledge past successes, not always failing)
Has proactively tried strategies such as budgeting and increasing study investment
negative_force: Self-labeling (failure), A cognitive pattern of overgeneralization and personalization
Catastrophizing and negative predictions about the future leading to avoidance behaviors
Avoids classes and is socially isolated, reducing external support and feedback
Weak social support, difficulty opening up to others and seeking help
Debt reminders and academic setbacks frequently triggering Anxiety and shame

antecedent: Faces academic challenges or realizes falling behind this semester
Failing exams or Anticipated poor grades
Anxiety and shame arising when preparing to go to class
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing academic setbacks and overgeneralizing them as 'I fail in every aspect', accompanied by personalization and intense shame, Weak social support Reinforcing the avoidance tendency
target_behavior.function: Temporarily avoiding evaluation and the sense of failure to lower current Anxiety/shame
target_behavior.consequence: Further academic damage, Increasing stress, declining Self-efficacy, forming a vicious cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Social isolation / reduced contact with others
antecedent: Thinking of needing to update friends/family on recent life
Worries about others' evaluations after academic setbacks
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and self-blame triggered by personalization and self-labeling, worrying about negative evaluation, thus turning the impulse to seek help into self-blame and Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: Avoiding exposure of the 'failed' self, reducing the risk of judgment and Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Further reduced Social support, Negative emotions persist and worsen, impaired daily self-care and functioning
